test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

I can’t begin to talk on this situation right now; I am still __wrapping my head around it.__

options.text: Comparing two things that can’t be compared

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"wrapping my head around"** means trying to understand something complicated or difficult. (समझने की कोशिश करना) • **Example:** It took me a while to **wrap my head around** the new software at work. • **Understanding** means grasping the meaning, significance, or nature of something. (समझना) • **Example:** She has a deep understanding of quantum physics. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Understanding something complicated**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Comparing two things that can’t be compared** (दो चीजों की तुलना करना जो तुलना नहीं की जा सकतीं) • **Example:** Comparing apples and oranges is pointless because they are so different. • **Option 3: Ignoring something completely** (किसी चीज को पूरी तरह से नजरअंदाज करना) • **Example:** He ignored the warning signs completely and continued driving. • **Option 4: Revealing a secret nobody knows** (एक ऐसा रहस्य उजागर करना जो कोई नहीं जानता) • **Example:** She revealed a secret nobody knew about her childhood. 48:Tbdd, The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
